description: Close a reservation whose outcome you reported unknown with settle_purchase, once, from what you checked (the processor's record, the wallet, the seller's order). Paid counts it at the amount paid. Not paid gives the amount back to today's budget, so only the workspace's owner may say so: a workspace-wide key with routing write scope, never an agent's own key. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

amount.description: With paid: what was actually paid, if less than reserved.

note.description: Required: what you checked, e.g. the processor reference.

name: reconcile_purchase
